summary: P0 Bug Fix Verified - All 8 test cases passed. The 'Couldn't find a navigation object' error from useFocusEffect has been fixed. After creating a symptom analysis and navigating back to home, the two buttons ('Letzte Analyse anzeigen' / 'Neue Analyse starten') now correctly appear instead of the single 'Analyse starten' button.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx: Line 34 - Synchronous state initialization `useState(() => getCurrentAnalysis() !== null)` correctly handles initial state without useFocusEffect
index.tsx: Lines 156-167 - hasSaved conditional rendering correctly shows SavedAnalysisButtons when analysis exists
SavedAnalysisButtons.tsx: Simplified to pure presentational component with no internal state - correct approach
store.ts: In-memory store with AsyncStorage persistence working correctly for state management across navigation
seed_data_creation: Created test symptom analyses: 'Kopfschmerzen und Müdigkeit' and 'Stress und Schlafprobleme'
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 Bug Fix VERIFIED. The useFocusEffect removal and synchronous state initialization fix is working correctly. All navigation flows work: disclaimer acceptance, symptom analysis creation, results viewing, back navigation shows two buttons, 'Letzte Analyse anzeigen' navigates to saved results, 'Neue Analyse starten' resets to input view.

test1_home_loads_without_crash.details: No 'Couldn't find a navigation object' error - useFocusEffect removal successful

test2_disclaimer_screen.details: Disclaimer screen shows with 'Verstanden & Zustimmen' button, acceptance works

test3_initial_state_analyze_button.details: 'Analyse starten' button visible when no saved analysis exists

test4_create_analysis_navigate_results.details: Symptom analysis creation works, navigates to results page

test5_p0_bug_fix_two_buttons.details: CRITICAL P0 FIX: After returning from results, TWO buttons appear ('Letzte Analyse anzeigen' and 'Neue Analyse starten')

test6_show_saved_analysis.details: 'Letzte Analyse anzeigen' button navigates to results page with saved analysis

test7_new_analysis_reset.details: 'Neue Analyse starten' button resets state, shows 'Analyse starten' button again

test8_repeat_analysis_flow.details: After second analysis, returning home shows two buttons again

p0_bug_fix_verification.original_issue: useFocusEffect from @react-navigation/native crashed the app with 'Couldn't find a navigation object' error
p0_bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Removed useFocusEffect, added synchronous state initialization via getCurrentAnalysis() !== null, simplified SavedAnalysisButtons to pure presentational component
p0_bug_fix_verification.verification_result: FIXED - All navigation flows work correctly, two buttons appear as expected after analysis
